name: What Counts as Protected Health Information
blurb: HIPAA definitions and de-identification for AI use.
title: What Counts as Protected Health Information
answer: Protected health information is individually identifiable information about a person's health, care or payment for care. HIPAA allows de-identified data to be used freely, either by removing 18 specified identifiers or by an expert determination that re-identification risk is very small.

reading.body:
HIPAA permits de-identified health data to be used freely, either by stripping 18 specified identifiers or by an expert determination that re-identification risk is very small.

The definition of protected health information turns on identifiability, not on sensitivity. Information about a person's health, care, or payment for care is protected only when it is individually identifiable. Remove that link and the data leaves the category entirely, which is why de-identification is the hinge on which most health AI training turns.

The two permitted routes are not equivalent in practice. Safe harbor is a fixed list of 18 identifiers, so it is mechanical and predictable. Expert determination is a judgment that re-identification risk is very small, which is the route the guidance points to for clinical notes, where free text defeats a checklist approach. For AI specifically, the distinction matters because training and testing corpora are usually built from exactly that kind of unstructured text.

What this does not cover is the rest of the compliance picture. It says nothing about how a model trained on de-identified data should be governed, what happens when outputs recombine into identifiable information, or how state law or the EU AI Act's high-risk deadlines interact with HIPAA. It also gives no numbers: no counts of covered entities, no breach statistics, no measure of how often either de-identification method is used.

A safe harbor is a legal rule that shields a person or company from being punished or sued if they follow certain approved steps, such as fixing a violation quickly or using a government approved compliance program.

sections.body: Clinical notes are hard to de-identify by safe harbor alone; use expert determination for free text used to train or test AI.
